# Introduction 

RQ: Does the color of the book predict the books genre

This paper explores whether there is a connection between the color of a book and its genre.

# Literature Review

Book Genre Prediction Using NLP: A Review [@vayadande2024book]

# Method

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import seaborn as sns

from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency

domain = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/'
path = "adamrossnelson/confident/refs/heads/main/data/"
file = "confident_fictional_books.csv"

books = pd.read_csv(domain + path + file)

```
Our null hypothesis it doesn't predict genre. We study this with `{python} f"{books.shape[0]}"` books where we know the books genre and the books cover color such that we can conduct a chi2 test to see if these two variables are either independe3nt to dependent
`{python} f"{books['book_genre'].nunique()}"`
`{python} f"{books['book_color'].nunique()}"`

# Results

```{python}
# Conduct the chi2 with chi2_contingency by passing the observed
x2, pval, degf, _ = chi2_contingency(
    pd.crosstab(books['book_genre'], books['book_color']))
```

Results: Chi2 stat: `{python} f"{round(x2,5)}"` - Pvalue: `{python} f"{round(pval, 10)}"` - degrees of freedom: `{python} f"{round(degf, 2)}"`.


# Discussion

Unfortunately, you cannot predict the genre of a book based on the color of it.
